title: “Faith solves problems logic can only measure.”
paragraphs: “Faith solves problems logic can only measure.”

When God does the math, your zero still equals everything.
Sometimes, grace carries the remainder.

Proverbs 3:5–6 (NIV)
“Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to Him, and He will make your paths straight.”
